codex.title: The Aethelgard Arcane Grimoire
codex.subtitle: A Treatise on Aether, Mana, Resonance, Flux, Sorcery, and the Laws That Keep Reality Whole
codex.canon_role: Foundational magical-system reference for Aethelgard. This document expands established canon while preserving Resonance, Flux, Ley-Tech, root-pulse, the Tear, and existing world terminology.
codex.catalog_principle: Magic is not a single force or school. It is an interaction between living capacity, ambient Aether, physical law, metaphysical identity, magical infrastructure, and the resistance of reality itself.

I_the_hidden_engine.aether: The universal magical substrate permeating matter, living beings, ley currents, and the spaces between worlds. Aether is not mana and is not normally generated by living creatures.
I_the_hidden_engine.mana: A living caster's usable magical reserve: the quantity of magical potential that can be safely shaped through the body's magical architecture.
I_the_hidden_engine.flux: Refined, pressurized magical current used by industrial and technological systems. Unlike ordinary personal mana, Flux can be stored, transported, engineered, and dangerously overextracted.
I_the_hidden_engine.ley_currents: Large-scale flows of Aether moving through geographical, planetary, and living structures. Ley currents can feed spells, ecosystems, wards, and magical infrastructure.
I_the_hidden_engine.root_pulse: A living magical current carried through ancient roots and preserved ecosystems. It is a natural expression of magical circulation rather than manufactured Flux.
I_the_hidden_engine.resonance: Inherited magical capacity associated with specific bloodlines. Resonance expresses through identity, affinity, and innate magical architecture rather than ordinary academic spellcraft.
I_the_hidden_engine.the_tear: A rupture in reality's structure. It is not merely a reservoir of stronger magic; it represents a violation of the separation between Aethelgard and whatever exists beyond it. Its effects do not obey ordinary magical assumptions consistently.

II_the_four_measures_of_a_mage.capacity: Maximum magical reserve that can be held safely.
II_the_four_measures_of_a_mage.recovery: Rate at which usable mana returns after expenditure.
II_the_four_measures_of_a_mage.conductivity: Efficiency with which magical energy travels through the body, focus, artifact, or conduit.
II_the_four_measures_of_a_mage.stability: Resistance to magical overload, backlash, mutation, and internal structural failure.
II_the_four_measures_of_a_mage.axiom: Raw mana does not determine mastery. A caster with enormous reserves may be inferior to a disciplined caster with a fraction of the power.

III_the_six_laws.name: Conservation
III_the_six_laws.law: Magic requires a source. Power cannot be produced from nothing without invoking a greater and usually more dangerous principle.

III_the_six_laws.name: Equivalent Burden
III_the_six_laws.law: The farther an effect departs from a thing's natural state, the greater the magical burden required to sustain it.

III_the_six_laws.name: Resonant Affinity
III_the_six_laws.law: Magic travels more efficiently through compatible bloodlines, materials, environments, symbols, and metaphysical structures.

III_the_six_laws.name: Complexity
III_the_six_laws.law: A spell's cost grows with the number of conditions, targets, transformations, calculations, and exceptions it must maintain.

III_the_six_laws.name: Conservation of Identity
III_the_six_laws.law: Magic cannot casually disregard what a living being, object, soul, or place fundamentally is. Transformations must contend with existing identity.

III_the_six_laws.name: Recoil
III_the_six_laws.law: Reality resists magical manipulation. Sufficiently forceful casting produces backlash in the caster, environment, magical network, or reality itself.

Arcanum.domain: Direct manipulation of magical energy and magical structure.
Arcanum.natural_affinities: Broadly learnable; strongest among trained scholars and highly conductive bloodlines.

Elementalism.domain: Manipulation of physical forces and elemental states.
Elementalism.advanced_principle: Masters manipulate principles such as combustion, thermal deprivation, pressure, mass, and electrical potential rather than merely producing visible elements.

Vitalism.domain: Living systems, healing, enhancement, disease, regeneration, biological alteration, and growth.
Vitalism.limitation: The caster must understand the structure being changed. Ignorance can produce malformed tissue, magical scarring, uncontrolled growth, organ failure, or neurological damage.

Spiritum.domain: Souls, consciousness, memory, dreams, death, possession, exorcism, and spiritual boundaries.
Spiritum.danger: Soul manipulation can create consequences that persist after the spell ends because the soul retains metaphysical memory of violation.

Naturae.domain: Living ecosystems, ancient forests, beasts, plants, seasonal cycles, and natural magical circulation.

Resonance.domain: Innate bloodline magic arising from inherited magical architecture.
Resonance.learnability: Study can improve control and understanding but cannot manufacture genuine Resonance in someone who does not possess it.
Resonance.known_case: Abel manifests rare natural projection ability and an unstable frost-associated Resonance expression.

Thaumaturgy.domain: Invocation and channeling through divine, transcendent, or higher metaphysical powers.
Thaumaturgy.distinction: A thaumaturge may function as a conduit rather than the sole source of the manifested power.
Thaumaturgy.known_deity: Solis is an established divine reference in Aethelgard.

V_spell_architecture.source: Where the energy originates: personal mana, ambient Aether, Flux, ley current, artifact, divine source, planar energy, or another living source.
V_spell_architecture.intent: The desired change, constrained by knowledge and the caster's ability to conceptualize the effect.
V_spell_architecture.formula: The magical pattern that converts intent into a stable effect.
V_spell_architecture.conduit: The path through which energy travels: body, weapon, staff, rune, artifact, ley line, root network, or engineered system.
V_spell_architecture.manifestation: The physical, spiritual, elemental, mental, or spatial result.
V_spell_architecture.recoil: The energetic, physiological, psychological, environmental, or metaphysical consequence produced by forcing the effect into existence.

VI_failure_spectrum.effect: Correct result accompanied by significant exhaustion or temporary instability.
Spell manifests incorrectly, incompletely, or with altered targeting.
Magical force returns toward the caster or conduit.
One failure triggers additional magical failures through linked effects or systems.
Caster's magical architecture suffers structural damage.
The surrounding magical environment is damaged or destabilized.
The spell produces an unintended magical entity, mutation, phenomenon, or impossible effect.
Reality itself becomes locally damaged. This lies outside ordinary spell failure and may permanently alter a region.

VII_dark_magic.definition: Dark magic is not merely evil magic. It is magic that deliberately violates, circumvents, or exploits one or more fundamental magical laws.

Blood Magic.method: Uses living blood as a sympathetic conductor and identity-bearing medium.

Soul Magic.method: Manipulates or consumes the metaphysical soul rather than ordinary magical reserves.
Soul Magic.danger: The soul is an active participant in the process rather than an inert resource.

Void Magic.method: Manipulates absence, magical negation, and the removal of magical properties.
Void Magic.extreme_risk: At sufficient intensity, removal can progress from magical properties toward matter and identity.

Reality Magic.method: Manipulates relationships that ordinary magic assumes are fixed: distance, probability, geometry, causality, and dimensional separation.
Reality Magic.risk: Repeated or large-scale use can destabilize the structure being manipulated.

Tearcraft.method: Attempts to interact directly with existing reality breaches.
Tearcraft.warning: The Tear is not simply another source of mana. Treating it as one can create catastrophic miscalculations.

VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.name: Chronomancy
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.principle: Manipulation of temporal rate, sequence, or local temporal relationship.
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.risk: Temporal recoil can create memory discontinuity, aging anomalies, paradoxical states, or temporal echoes.

VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.name: Causality Magic
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.principle: Manipulation of relationships between causes and outcomes.
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.risk: Extremely unstable because the caster must alter chains of events rather than isolated objects.

VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.name: Name Magic
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.principle: Manipulation of the metaphysical identity of a person, creature, place, or object through its true identity structure.
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.risk: Misidentification can damage the caster's own identity or bind the wrong target.

VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.name: True Resurrection
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.principle: Restoration of an entire dead identity rather than animation of a corpse.
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.risk: Requires the metaphysical integrity of the soul and body to be reconciled.

VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.name: Reality Weaving
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.principle: Direct alteration of the rules governing a region of reality.
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.risk: Can create persistent magical laws that outlive the caster.

VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.name: Planar Convergence
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.principle: Forces two separate planes or existential domains into partial overlap.
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.risk: Ecological, magical, biological, and metaphysical contamination.

VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.name: Absolute Binding
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.principle: Creates restrictions designed to prevent an entity from escaping through physical, magical, spiritual, or dimensional means.
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.risk: The binding must account for every escape vector; an omitted exception can become a fatal weakness.

VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.name: Nullification
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.principle: Attempts to remove magical properties from existence rather than merely suppressing them.
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.risk: Advanced nullification can damage the conceptual identity of enchanted objects, spells, and living beings.

VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.name: Ascendant Magic
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.principle: Temporarily elevates a mortal's magical architecture toward a higher-order state.
VIII_advanced_forbidden_disciplines.risk: The body and identity may fail to return cleanly to mortal configuration.

IX_mana_states.name: Starved
IX_mana_states.description: Mana reserve insufficient for normal magical function; attempted casting becomes dangerous.

IX_mana_states.name: Saturated
IX_mana_states.description: Excess magical energy accumulated faster than it can safely circulate.

IX_mana_states.name: Overcharged
IX_mana_states.description: Mana pressure exceeds safe operating limits and begins producing recoil.

IX_mana_states.name: Poisoned
IX_mana_states.description: Foreign or unstable magical energy has contaminated the caster's internal circulation.

IX_mana_states.name: Fractured
IX_mana_states.description: Magical architecture has suffered structural damage, causing unpredictable spell behavior.

X_magical_contamination.Flux Poisoning: Long-term exposure to industrial Flux can produce neurological, physiological, and magical abnormalities.
X_magical_contamination.Ley Sickness: Instability caused by prolonged exposure to turbulent or damaged ley currents.
X_magical_contamination.Resonance Burn: Overloading an innate bloodline Resonance beyond the body's stable tolerance.
X_magical_contamination.Soul Fracture: Damage to the continuity of spiritual identity.
X_magical_contamination.Void Scarring: Persistent alteration caused by contact with reality-negating or Tear-adjacent phenomena.
X_magical_contamination.Wildgrowth: Excessive Naturae exposure causing uncontrolled biological or ecological growth.

Human.natural_profile: Highly adaptable magical architecture; broad compatibility but no single dominant natural affinity.

Elf.natural_profile: High conductivity and strong compatibility with Arcanum, Naturae, Resonance, enchantment, and living magical systems.
Elf.typical_strength: Long-term magical study and environmental integration.

Dwarf.natural_profile: Exceptional stability and resistance to magical strain.
Dwarf.typical_strength: Runic engineering, geomancy, artificing, Flux systems, and durable magical construction.

Halfling.natural_profile: Reserved for future detailed development; no universal assumption of magical weakness or strength.

Tiefling.natural_profile: Potential compatibility with fiendish and infernal magical structures without implying moral alignment.
Tiefling.typical_strength: High-risk pact and fire-adjacent traditions remain subject to individual lineage.

Dragonborn.natural_profile: Strong elemental and ancestral resonance, often expressed through draconic physiology.
Dragonborn.typical_strength: Elemental projection and inherited magical traits.

Feline-Kin.natural_profile: Strong potential for sensory, instinctive, movement, illusion, and subtle magical expression.

XII_three_origins_of_magic.Innate: Magic generated or expressed through the creature's own magical architecture. Examples include Resonance and certain racial traits.
XII_three_origins_of_magic.Learned: Magic developed through study, formula, discipline, language, ritual, training, and technique.
XII_three_origins_of_magic.Granted: Power channeled through an external entity, artifact, covenant, divine source, or other higher structure.
XII_three_origins_of_magic.hybridization: A single individual may possess multiple origins simultaneously. Hybrid casters are not automatically stronger; incompatible magical architectures can create severe instability.

XIII_creature_magical_architecture.principle: Magical creatures possess magical biology or metaphysical structures just as naturally occurring animals possess organs and nervous systems.

examples.name: Ley Leech
examples.architecture: Feeds on magical currents rather than ordinary blood and can attach to ley lines, spellcasters, artifacts, enchanted armor, and Ley-Tech systems.

examples.name: Flux Revenant
examples.architecture: A corpse animated by accumulated magical residue and residual magical instructions rather than conventional biological life.

examples.name: Void-Touched Beast
examples.architecture: A creature altered by proximity to reality breaches, potentially exhibiting impossible movement, distorted senses, or abnormal resistance to conventional magic.

examples.name: Rootbound Sentinel
examples.architecture: A plant-construct whose body is itself a continuous magical working tied to the root-pulse and ancient living systems.

XIV_spell_taxonomy.Cantrip: A low-complexity magical pattern with minimal sustained burden.
XIV_spell_taxonomy.Working: A standard repeatable spell or technique requiring deliberate shaping.
XIV_spell_taxonomy.Ritual: A complex effect whose cost is reduced or distributed through time, preparation, materials, participants, symbols, or location.
XIV_spell_taxonomy.Grand Working: A large-scale magical operation affecting structures, populations, weather, ley currents, or regions.
XIV_spell_taxonomy.Relic Art: A magical effect permanently encoded into an artifact or inherited magical object.
XIV_spell_taxonomy.Bloodright Art: A technique whose full function depends upon a specific bloodline or Resonance architecture.
XIV_spell_taxonomy.Forbidden Working: A technique prohibited because of catastrophic risk, violation of magical law, abuse potential, or metaphysical consequences.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Aegis Ward
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: Creates a shaped defensive field that distributes incoming magical or physical force across a stable boundary.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: Repeated impacts progressively destabilize the field unless the caster reinforces its structure.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Null Thread
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: Severs a localized magical connection between a spell and its conduit.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: Cannot automatically erase the energy already released by the spell.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Frost Lance
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: Compresses thermal deprivation into a focused penetrating projectile.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: Efficiency decreases sharply against targets with extreme thermal or magical resistance.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Rootwake
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: Temporarily awakens dormant magical activity within living roots and directs it toward a defined purpose.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: Requires living root structures and can damage ecosystems if repeatedly forced.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Soul Lantern
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: Reveals spiritual residue left behind by recently departed consciousness.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: Does not automatically communicate with the dead and cannot reconstruct a complete soul from residue alone.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Bloodmark
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: Creates a sympathetic magical link through a blood sample.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: The link weakens with distance, time, deliberate countermeasures, and destruction of the sympathetic medium.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Ley Step
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: Moves the caster along a stable magical current for a short distance.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: Requires a usable ley path and becomes dangerous where currents are damaged or contaminated.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Resonant Break
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: A rare bloodline technique that disrupts the structure of an incoming magical effect through incompatible resonance.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: Requires extraordinary compatibility and can cause severe Resonance Burn.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Crown of Silence
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: Suppresses detectable magical emissions within a controlled radius.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: Does not erase existing physical evidence and becomes harder to maintain as the radius grows.

XV_core_spell_lexicon.name: Tearglass
XV_core_spell_lexicon.effect: Allows a prepared magical medium to observe distortions surrounding a reality breach without directly entering it.
XV_core_spell_lexicon.limit: Observation itself can attract unstable phenomena and prolonged use risks Void Scarring.

XVI_magical_engineering.Ley-Tech: Technology designed to conduct, redirect, or manipulate magical currents.
XVI_magical_engineering.Monolith_Stabilization_Arrays: Foundational systems used to stabilize regional magical and reality currents.
XVI_magical_engineering.Iron_Vein_Filtration: Industrial filtration systems associated with Flux extraction; repeated extraction can create environmental and magical consequences.
XVI_magical_engineering.Ley_Shield: A colossal protective energy barrier surrounding Kael-Vossen.
XVI_magical_engineering.principle: Magical engineering differs from ordinary spellcasting because the system stores, distributes, and transforms power independently of a single caster.

XVIII_unwritten_truths.truth_01: The oldest magical records are incomplete and contradictory.
XVIII_unwritten_truths.truth_02: No known civilization possesses a complete theory of all magical disciplines.
XVIII_unwritten_truths.truth_03: The Tear cannot safely be reduced to ordinary Arcana, Flux, or planar theory.
XVIII_unwritten_truths.truth_04: Resonance bloodlines may contain capabilities that have never been academically classified.
XVIII_unwritten_truths.truth_05: Magic remembers patterns. Repeated use can leave environmental, spiritual, or metaphysical residues long after a caster leaves.
XVIII_unwritten_truths.truth_06: Some magical phenomena are not spells at all. They are properties of places, creatures, bloodlines, artifacts, or reality itself.

codex.design_rule_for_future_entries: Future spells, creatures, artifacts, bloodlines, rituals, curses, magical technologies, and magical diseases should identify their source, discipline, compatibility, cost, limitations, failure modes, and relationship to established Aethelgard canon. New entries must not silently overwrite existing canon.
